data.title: NVIDIA Allegedly Engineered Scarcity By Funding AI Startups To Buy Its GPUs
data.description: Following the departure of now-former NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, a new report by The Wall Street Journal (via Wccftech) has emerged alleging that NVIDIA artificially inflated the ongoing GPU and memory shortage by investing in AI startups that would go on to buy NVIDIA GPUs and build data centers....
